assessments.reasoning: Verified byte range [1708,3497), SHA-256 97b4cf38b21d924c0545405c201b1d4dd7f30dd61dd27f0c34bc39e941b54e91, contains Noncompete, Competition, New Products, Discontinued Products and Sales of Business in sequence.

limitations: The finding describes the terms on the stated assumption of reliance on this edition. Actual competitive status, affiliate relationships, qualifying versions, sales and legal enforceability require separate evidence.
reasoning: Shield excludes the purpose of providing a product that competes with either the covered software itself or a product the licensor or any affiliate provides using that software. New Products allows a user already providing a noncompeting product to continue with versions previously available under these terms if the licensor or an affiliate creates the competition through a new software version or another product using the software. Later versions fall outside that permission. Discontinued Products allows starting to compete with a product or service the licensor or an affiliate has stopped providing, unless the licensor includes with the software a plain-text line beginning “Licensor Line of Business:” that mentions that line of business. Sales of Business says a buyer of a licensor or affiliate line of business developing the software or using it to provide a product can also enforce Noncompete for that product.
